title: A status change records who and when, with an optional note of 255 characters
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
custom_steps:
1. Change a part's status with a note and confirm; check the recorded user and date/time.
  2. Try a note longer than 255 characters by a route that allows it; read the message.
  3. Change a status leaving the note empty.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every status change records which user made it and the date and time; the user can add an optional note of at most 255 characters.
  • A note longer than 255 characters refuses the change with "A note cannot be longer than 255 characters."; leaving the note empty is allowed and records no note.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 10 (Confirming & recording a status change); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R8: “Every status change records which user made it.”
  • S10-R9: “Every status change records the date and time it was made.”
  • S10-R10: “The user can add an optional note when changing a status.”
  • S10-R11: “A note can be at most 255 characters.”
  • S10-R12: “If a note is longer than 255 characters, the change is refused with the message "A note cannot be longer than 255 characters."”
  • S10-R13: “Leaving the note empty is allowed and records no note.”
